title: MMFineReason: Closing the Multimodal Reasoning Gap via Open Data-Centric Methods
authors_zh: Honglin Lin, Zheng Liu, Yun Zhu, Chonghan Qin, Juekai Lin, Xiaoran Shang, Conghui He, Wentao Zhang, Lijun Wu
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理数据构造与筛选
best_for_zh: 适合构建或筛选多模态长思维链数据，并用于 SFT 和后续 RL 的研究人员。
one_line: MMFineReason distills and filters 1.8M multimodal long-CoT examples, then selects a 123K difficult subset that retains most of the training gain.
MMFineReason 蒸馏并筛选出 181 万条多模态长思维链样本，再选出 12.3 万条难例，以较少数据保留大部分训练收益。
why: It shows how source normalization, answer consistency, deduplication, and student-relative difficulty can make multimodal reasoning data more efficient.
inclusion_reason: MMFineReason provides a reproducible quality-and-difficulty pipeline for turning pooled multimodal tasks into long-CoT post-training data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal reasoning models lag behind text-only reasoning partly because open post-training corpora are fragmented, inconsistently formatted, and often lack reliable long reasoning traces. Simply pooling more records also wastes compute on duplicates, easy items, or teacher outputs whose final answers do not match the reference.

MMFineReason builds a data-centric pipeline: standardize public multimodal tasks, distill visually grounded reasoning from a large teacher, filter low-quality or duplicate records, and estimate student-relative difficulty. The result is both a large training corpus and a compact difficult subset for efficient SFT.

L4 facts: Primary source arXiv:2601.21821 (2026); status: arXiv preprint; decision boundary: retain after quality checks and optionally select by four-rollout difficulty; data object: multimodal prompt, teacher trace, answer, lineage, and selection signals; collection note: directly concerns instruction, demonstration, and rationale data.

多模态推理模型落后于纯文本推理模型，部分原因在于开放的后训练语料来源分散、格式不统一，而且常常缺少可靠的长推理轨迹。单纯汇总更多记录还会把算力浪费在重复样本、简单样本，或最终答案与参考答案不一致的 teacher 输出上。

MMFineReason 建立了一条以数据为中心的流程：标准化公开多模态任务，使用大模型 teacher 蒸馏视觉相关的推理过程，过滤低质量和重复记录，再估计相对于 student 的难度。最终既得到大规模训练语料，也得到适合高效 SFT 的紧凑难例子集。

L4 事实：主来源为 arXiv:2601.21821（2026 年）；状态为 arXiv 预印本；判定边界为通过质量检查后保留，并可按四次 rollout 的难度进一步筛选；数据对象包括多模态提示、teacher 轨迹、答案、血缘和筛选信号；收录理由是它直接研究指令、示范和推理过程数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is to connect corpus scale with data efficiency: generate a clean 1.8M-example long-CoT corpus, then use a smaller model's repeated success rate to select 123K examples that are hard enough to remain useful. Quality and difficulty are separate gates, so an example must first be trustworthy before its training value is estimated.

Google Scholar citations: 26（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=MMFineReason%3A+Closing+the+Multimodal+Reasoning+Gap+via+Open+Data-Centric+Methods&author=Honglin+Lin&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. - Name: MMFineReason collection, including MMFineReason-1.8M, MMFineReason-123K, and the 2.3M full pool. - Official URL: https://huggingface.co/collections/OpenDataArena/mmfinereason - Scale: 1,810,926 filtered records; 122,603 difficult-subset records; 2,286,130 full-pool records. - Form and license: Parquet datasets under Apache-2.0, with multimodal prompts, generated reasoning, answers, and metadata. - Intended use: multimodal reasoning SFT, data-ablation studies, difficulty-aware selection, and later RL initialization.

核心贡献是把语料规模与数据效率连接起来：先生成 181 万条干净的长思维链语料，再根据较小模型的重复作答成功率，选出 12.3 万条仍有训练价值的难例。质量和难度是两个独立关卡，因此样本必须先可信，之后才能估计训练价值。

Google Scholar 引用数：26（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=MMFineReason%3A+Closing+the+Multimodal+Reasoning+Gap+via+Open+Data-Centric+Methods&author=Honglin+Lin&hl=en）

开源数据：有。 - 名称：MMFineReason 系列，包括 MMFineReason-1.8M、MMFineReason-123K 和 230 万条完整数据池。 - 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/collections/OpenDataArena/mmfinereason - 规模：筛选后 1,810,926 条；难例子集 122,603 条；完整数据池 2,286,130 条。 - 形式与许可：Apache-2.0 许可的 Parquet 数据集，包含多模态提示、生成的推理过程、答案和元数据。 - 用途：多模态推理 SFT、数据消融、难度感知筛选，以及后续 RL 的初始化。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect and normalize. Input: FineVision, BMMR, Euclid30K, Zebra-CoT-Physics, GameQA-140K, and other public multimodal tasks. Operation: clean, translate where needed, and map records into one schema. Output: a 2.3M-example pool. Check: retain source lineage and validate image-question-answer alignment.
  2. Generate long reasoning. Input: each normalized prompt and visual input. Operation: ask Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking for a think trace and final answer. Output: visually grounded candidate rationales. Check: enforce the expected think/answer structure and length limits.
  3. Filter quality and duplicates. Input: teacher candidates. Operation: apply template and length checks, remove 50-gram duplicates, and compare generated answers with references. Output: 1.8M filtered examples containing about 5.1B solution tokens. Check: answer agreement is a retention signal, not proof that every intermediate step is faithful.
  4. Estimate difficulty. Input: filtered examples. Operation: let Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking solve each item four times and use its success rate as student-relative difficulty. Output: per-item difficulty observations. Check: keep the model, sampling protocol, and answer judge fixed across records.
  5. Select the compact set. Input: difficulty observations and quality-approved examples. Operation: retain records that the 4B student does not solve reliably. Output: the 123K difficult subset. Check: the subset contains only records that already passed quality filtering.
  6. Train and evaluate. Input: the 1.8M or 123K corpus. Operation: SFT Qwen3-VL 2B, 4B, and 8B models, with a separate GSPO RL experiment. Output: MFR checkpoints and benchmark scores. Check: compare data variants under matched base models and training settings.

Reproducibility: the official Hugging Face collection exposes the three dataset variants and schemas. Reuse still requires checking source-specific image rights, exact generation prompts, model revisions, deduplication implementation, and answer normalizers.

1. 收集并标准化。 输入：FineVision、BMMR、Euclid30K、Zebra-CoT-Physics、GameQA-140K 等公开多模态任务。操作：清洗数据，必要时翻译，并映射到统一 schema。输出：约 230 万条样本池。检查：保留来源血缘，并验证图像、问题和答案的对应关系。
  2. 生成长推理过程。 输入：每条标准化提示和视觉输入。操作：让 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking 生成思考轨迹和最终答案。输出：与视觉内容相关的候选推理。检查：强制使用预期的思考/答案结构和长度限制。
  3. 过滤质量与重复。 输入：teacher 候选结果。操作：执行模板和长度检查，移除 50-gram 重复，并比较生成答案与参考答案。输出：181 万条筛选样本，约含 51 亿个解答 token。检查：答案一致只是保留信号，不能证明每个中间步骤都忠实。
  4. 估计难度。 输入：筛选后的样本。操作：让 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 对每题作答四次，以成功率表示相对于 student 的难度。输出：逐题难度观测。检查：所有样本必须使用相同模型、采样协议和答案判定器。
  5. 选择紧凑子集。 输入：难度观测和已通过质量检查的样本。操作：保留 4B student 无法稳定解出的记录。输出：12.3 万条难例子集。检查：子集中的记录必须已经通过质量过滤。
  6. 训练并评测。 输入：181 万条全量语料或 12.3 万条子集。操作：对 Qwen3-VL 2B、4B 和 8B 模型做 SFT，并另行进行 GSPO RL 实验。输出：MFR checkpoint 和 benchmark 分数。检查：比较数据版本时保持 base model 和训练设置一致。

复现要求：官方 Hugging Face collection 已提供三个数据版本及其 schema。复用时仍需核对各来源的图像权利、生成提示、模型 revision、去重实现和答案归一化规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Main model comparison. Claim: the filtered corpus closes part of the multimodal reasoning gap at moderate model scale. Controlled setup: MFR-8B is obtained by SFT from the Qwen3-VL-8B family and is compared across the paper's reasoning benchmark suite with Qwen3-VL thinking baselines. MFR-8B averages 75.7, versus 72.5 for Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and 74.5 for Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. Boundary: the aggregate combines heterogeneous tasks, so per-task regressions should still be inspected.

Data-efficiency comparison. Claim: difficulty selection preserves most of the gain with much less data. Controlled setup: models use the same pipeline while training data changes from the filtered 1.8M corpus to the 123K hard subset. The 123K variant averages 73.3 while using about 7% as many examples. Boundary: difficulty is defined by Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking and may select a different frontier for another student.

主模型对比。 主张：筛选后的语料能让中等规模模型缩小多模态推理差距。可比设置：MFR-8B 基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 系列做 SFT，并在论文的推理 benchmark 组合上与 Qwen3-VL thinking 基线比较。MFR-8B 平均分为 75.7，Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 为 72.5，Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B 为 74.5。边界：总分汇总了不同任务，仍需检查单项退化。

数据效率对比。 主张：按难度筛选能用明显更少的数据保留大部分收益。可比设置：训练流程不变，只把数据从筛选后的 181 万条全量语料换成 12.3 万条难例子集。12.3 万条版本的平均分为 73.3，只使用约 7% 的样本。边界：难度由 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 定义，换用其他 student 时前沿可能不同。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior multimodal corpora often emphasize either scale, teacher-generated long CoT, or benchmark-specific hard examples. MMFineReason combines source normalization, long-CoT distillation, explicit quality filtering, and student-relative difficulty selection in one open pipeline, then measures the trade-off between a 1.8M corpus and a 123K subset. The individual tools are established; the new signal is their integrated, scale-tested data recipe.
以往多模态语料通常分别强调规模、teacher 生成的长思维链，或面向特定 benchmark 的难例。MMFineReason 把来源标准化、长思维链蒸馏、显式质量过滤和相对于 student 的难度筛选整合进一条开放流程，并测量 181 万条语料与 12.3 万条子集之间的取舍。各个工具本身已有先例，新意在于经过规模验证的整合数据配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Process faithfulness is not verified. Final-answer consistency can retain plausible but incorrect intermediate reasoning. Sample traces should be checked with step-level or visual-grounding verification before reuse.
  • Difficulty is model-relative. The 123K subset reflects failures of Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking, not an intrinsic ordering for every model. Recompute difficulty for a substantially different student.
  • Mixed-source rights and leakage. Apache-2.0 on the combined release does not replace source-level image and dataset terms, and 50-gram deduplication does not prove benchmark decontamination. Audit provenance and evaluation overlap locally.

• 没有验证过程忠实性。 最终答案一致仍可能保留看似合理但中间步骤错误的推理。复用前应抽样做步骤级或视觉落地检查。
  • 难度取决于模型。 12.3 万条子集反映的是 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 的失败，而不是对所有模型都成立的内在排序。若 student 差异较大，应重新计算难度。
  • 混合来源的权利与泄漏。 合并数据的 Apache-2.0 许可不能替代各来源的图像和数据条款，50-gram 去重也不能证明没有 benchmark 污染。应在本地审计来源和评测重叠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use MMFineReason when training a multimodal model that needs explicit long reasoning rather than short answers. Start with the 123K subset for a compute-limited SFT baseline, then move to 1.8M only if scaling tests justify the cost; preserve source and selection metadata so failures can be traced. Success means gains on held-out multimodal reasoning tasks without worse visual grounding or answer calibration. Do not treat the teacher trace as automatically correct, or redistribute source images without checking their terms.
当多模态模型需要显式长推理过程而不是短答案时，可以使用 MMFineReason。算力有限时先用 12.3 万条子集建立 SFT 基线，只有规模实验能证明收益时再扩展到 181 万条；同时保留来源和筛选元数据，以便追踪失败。成功标准是在留出的多模态推理任务上提升，同时不损害视觉落地和答案校准。不要把 teacher 轨迹自动视为正确，也不要在未检查条款时重新分发来源图像。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. MMFineReason is both a 1.8M data release and a quality-plus-difficulty selection recipe.
  2. Each useful record joins a multimodal prompt, teacher reasoning, final answer, lineage, and selection signals.
  3. The 123K result is the key efficiency finding: about 7% of the examples reaches a 73.3 average.
  4. Answer agreement and 50-gram deduplication do not guarantee faithful reasoning or benchmark cleanliness.
  5. Before reuse, verify source rights, schemas, model revisions, answer normalization, and student-relative difficulty.

1. MMFineReason 既是 181 万条数据的开放发布，也是质量加难度的筛选配方。
  2. 有用记录由多模态提示、teacher 推理、最终答案、来源血缘和筛选信号组成。
  3. 12.3 万条结果是关键效率结论：使用约 7% 的样本即可达到 73.3 的平均分。
  4. 答案一致和 50-gram 去重不能保证推理忠实，也不能保证 benchmark 干净。
  5. 复用前应核对来源权利、schema、模型 revision、答案归一化和相对于 student 的难度。

value.html: Standardized multimodal tasks pooled from public datasets including FineVision, BMMR, Euclid30K, Zebra-CoT-Physics, and GameQA-140K.
Image or diagram, question, think trace, final answer, source metadata, and quality or difficulty signals.
Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking generates visually grounded long-form reasoning.
Static multimodal question answering with images, diagrams, and text.
Format and length checks, 50-gram deduplication, answer-consistency filtering, and four-rollout difficulty estimation.
Retain a standardized record only after quality filtering; include it in the compact subset when Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking does not solve it reliably across four attempts.
Qwen3-VL 2B, 4B, and 8B models are trained; Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking estimates difficulty.
Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking.
Normalize pooled tasks, generate think and answer fields with the teacher, filter quality and duplicates, then estimate difficulty.
The full standardized pool has about 2.3M records; quality filtering yields 1.8M, and difficulty selection yields 123K.
Apply template and length checks, remove 50-gram duplicates, require answer consistency, and rank records by four-rollout student success.
One teacher trace per retained example plus four Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking attempts for difficulty selection.
SFT on the 1.8M or 123K corpus; the paper also evaluates a GSPO reinforcement-learning stage.
Multiple public multimodal datasets spanning mathematics, science, charts, diagrams, games, and general visual question answering.
The release provides full 2.3M, filtered 1.8M, and difficult 123K variants; benchmark splits remain task-specific.
50-gram deduplication reduces internal repetition, but does not establish benchmark-level decontamination for every source.
